s: Din betza shennoladah beyom tob ubo y"t seipim: betza shennoleda beyom tob shechal lihyot achar hashshabbat o beshabbat sheachar yom tob — asura baakila bo bayyom min hattora, lepi shekkol betza shennoleda beyom zeh kebar hi nigmeret bime hattarnegolet beyom shellepanayv, venimtza sheyyom etmol hekin et habbetza leoklah beyom zeh shennoleda bo, veim etmol haya shabbat o yom tob, nimtza sheshshabbat o yom tob hekin vetiqqen akilat yom tob o shabbat sheacharayv, vehattora omra: "vehaya bayyom hashshishshi vehekinu et asher yabiu vego'", veen hakkatub medabber baapiyya ubishshul ushear tiqqun tzorke seudda hannaasim bide adam, shehare kebar neemar: "et asher topu epu vego'", ha en hakkatub medabber ella bahakanat shamayim, kegon betza shennigmeret bime immah umukenet leoklah lemachar, veomra tora: "bayyom hashshishshi", kelomar setam shishshi yom chol hu, ubo "vehekinu et asher yabiu", kelomar yom zeh shehu chol mekin akilat yom qodesh shelleacharayv, abal yom qodesh, dehaynu yom tob, eno mekin leyom qodesh shelleacharayv, ubetza shennigmera bime immah beyom tob asura beshabbat shelleacharayv, veken shennigmera beshabbat asura beyom tob shelleacharayv, sheggam yom tob niqra shabbat, vaakilato hi chashuba beene hammaqom lehatzrik lah hakana vehazmana miyyom chol kemo shabbat. Abal betza shennoleda bemotzae shabbat o bemotzae yom tob — mutteret baakila bo bayyom, sheen akilat hachol chashuba kelum, velo shayyak bah kelal hakana vehazmana.

Umiddibre soperim shekkol betza shennoleda beshabbat sheeno leachar yom tob o beyom tob sheeno leachar hashshabbat, apillu noleda mittarnegolet haomedet laakila sheen kan din muqtzeh kelal — hare zo asura baakila ad laereb, gezera mishshum betza shennoleda beshabbat shelleachar yom tob o beyom tob shelleachar hashshabbat.

Vekevan shehi asura baakila — asura gam ken betiltul, shehare enah reuya liklum bo bayyom. Vaapillu ligga bah asur, ap al pi shemmuttar ligga bekol dabar shehu muqtzeh veeno asur ella betiltul, mikkol maqom, kevan shehabbetza hi agulla, im yigga bah qarob haddabar sheyyezizenna meat. Abal muttar likpot aleha keli bishbil shello tishshaber, ubilbad shello yigga bah hakkeli, ayyen simman sh"ch.

Veim nitorba bebetzim acherot — kullan asurot baakila ubetiltul, veenah betela apillu beelep betzim, shehare lemachar hi mutteret belo bittul, vekol dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin apillu beelep eno batel. Vaapillu im hu sapeq im noleda beyom tob o bechol — kullan asurot, kevan sheyyakol leoklam lemachar behetter. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beyom tob rishon, abal beyom tob sheni shel galuyyot yesh lehattir hattaarobet shennitareb bo sepeq betza shennoleda beyom tob im hu tzarik lebetzim hallalu lesimchat yom tob, kevan sheap qodem shennitorba hayu kan shette sepeqot: sapeq yom tob sapeq chol, sapeq noleda beyom tob sapeq noleda bechol. Abal beyom tob rishon yesh lehachamir bispeq betza shennoleda beyom tob apillu bishte taarobot, dehaynu shemmin taarobet harishon nopla betza achat letok elep betzim acherot — kullan asurot baakila ubetiltul, dekevan sheyyesh lahem hetter akila lemachar — en lismok al mah shennitbattela betza haasura bekamma taarobot betzim shel hetter.

Vekol zeh kesheeno makkir et habbetza haasura, abal im hu makkirah, apillu im nitbashshelu immah venotna bahem taam — hare hi bilbaddah asura ushear habbetzim muttarot im yesh bahen shishshim (dehaynu s"a betzim, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman p"v ayyen sham) keneged betza haasura, shello hechemiru beissur sheyyesh lo mattirin ella bemammasho shel issur shennitareb, abal im en sham mammasho shel issur ella tamo bilbad — hu batel beshishshim kishar kol haissurin. Vehu shello nitkavven lebattelo bemezid, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea simman tz"t ayyen sham. Veim betza haasura hi shelema biqlippatah — apillu shishshim enah tzerika, lepi sheenah poletet kelal miggupah, shehaqqelippa meakkabtah milliplot. Veim betza haasura hi qelupa ubetzim shel hetter shennitbashshelu imma enan qelupot, im yesh babbetzim shel hetter im qelippotehem veim hammayim shennitbashshelu bahem s"a keneged betza haasura — muttar leoklan beyom tob, ayyen beyoreh dea simman p"v.

Vekol zeh keshennitbashshela im betzim acherot, abal im nitbashshela im basar o shear mine tabshilin, apillu nimmocha kol habbetza veniblela battabshil, im yesh battabshil shishshim kenegdah — muttar leoklo bo bayyom ap al pi sheyyesh bo mammasho shel issur sheyyesh lo mattirin, lepi shello hechemiru be"dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin" ella keshennitareb min bemino, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea simman q"b, ayyen sham hattaam.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshello netanah baqqedera kede letaqqen et hattabshil, ella kede shettitbashshel biqdera zo im hattabshil veyoklenna bipne atzmah, abal im netanah baqqedera letaqqen hattabshil, kegon lelabbeno, o shemmilleah battarnegolet im taarobet shear minim, ap al pi sheyyesh battaarobet shishshim kenegdah — enah betela, ap al pi shebbebetza zo bilbad en bah kede letaqqen hattabshil velo lelabbeno ella al yede shemmeareb immah debarim acherim, mikkol maqom, kevan shehi baa battabshil letaqqeno — hare hi nechshebet min echad im hattabshil, ukebar nitbaer shekkol dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin shennitareb min bemino eno batel apillu beelep ap al pi sheen tamo nirgash kelal.

Noleda beyom tob rishon — mutteret belel yom tob sheni shel galuyyot miyyad, shehare mimma napshak echad mehen hu chol, abal shene yamim tobim shel rosh hashshana noleda barishon asura ap bashsheni, mippene sheshshene hayyamim hen qodesh ukeyom echad arok hen chashubim.

Shabbat veyom tob hassemukim zeh lazeh, betza shennoleda barishon asura ap bashsheni ad haereb, lepi sheal yede leda zo hi mukenet laakila, sheyyoter toba hi laakila betza shennoleda veyotza laavir haolam mibbetza hannimtzet bime tarnegolet hashshechuta, ukebar nitbaer sheen yom tob mekin leshabbat velo shabbat leyom tob. Veissur zeh eno ella middibre soperim, shehare betza zo min hattora muttar leoklah bo bayyom shennoleda, shehare nigmera bime immah meereb shabbat o meereb yom tob, vekevan shemmutteret bo bayyom, nimtza sheal yede leda zo hukena leoklah bo bayyom, ulepikak hi mutteret gam bayyom shelleacharayv, kevan sheyyom zeh leatzmo hekin velo layyom sheacharayv. Vaapillu yom zeh shennoleda bo shabbat, shei epshar lebashshelah uleoklah, mikkol maqom reuya legomah chayya, ella kevan shemmiddibre soperim asur leoklah bayyom shennoleda kemo shennitbaer, nimtza sheyyom zeh shennoleda bo hekin et habbetza leoklah bayyom shelleacharayv, vekevan sheen yom tob mekin leshabbat velo shabbat leyom tob, lepikak asur leoklah gam bayyom shelleacharayv middibre soperim.

Yom tob sheni shel galuyyot hassamuk leshabbat ben millepanayv ben milleacharayv — dino keyom tob rishon leinyan zeh. Veim shene yamim tobim shel galuyyot chalu lihyot achar hashshabbat — betza shennoleda beshabbat mutteret baakila beyom tob sheni, shehare im yom sheni hu qodesh yom harishon hu chol, venimtza sheyyom chol mapsiq ben ledat habbetza laakilatah. Abal im shene yamim tobim shel rosh hashshana chalu lihyot lipne hashshabbat — betza shennoleda beyom tob rishon asura ap beshabbat ad haereb, mippene sheshshene hayyamim hen qedushsha achat ukeyom echad arok hen chashubin.

Betza sheyyotza rubbah mimmee immah vechozra lime immah meereb yom tob veachar kak noleda kullah beyom tob — mutteret baakila bo bayyom, dekevan sheyyotza rubbah meereb yom tob — hare hi keillu kebar noleda kullah meereb yom tob. Lepikak, apillu badaq beqinnah shel tarnegolet ereb yom tob samuk lachasheka velo matza bah betza ulemachar hishkim qodem alot hashshachar umatza bah betza — mutteret, shettarnegolet enah yoledet kelal ballayla, ubevadday yotza rubbah mimmee immah beereb yom tob bayyom veachar kak chozra lime immah, ulepikak lo matza kelum keshebbadaq, veachar kak belel yom tob noleda kullah, dekevan sheyyotza rubbah bayyom — hare kebar noleda bayyom, vikola lachazor velatzet ballayla.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheyyesh tarnegol zakar tok shishshim battim limqom hattarnegolet veen mapsiq benehem nahar sheen bo gesher, dekevan sheyyekola labo etzel hattarnegol — bevadday betza zo mehattarnegol hi, ubetza hannoledet mechamat tarnegol enah noledet ella bayyom. Abal im en tarnegol zakar tok shishshim battim limqom hattarnegolet, o shemmapsiq benehem nahar sheen bo gesher beinyan sheen derek hattarnegolet labo etzel hattarnegol, veaz darkah lehitapper beapar lehitchammem veleled betzim, ubetzim hallalu ap sherob happeamim darkan lehivvaled bayyom, mikkol maqom peamim shehen noladin ap ballayla, lepikak im badaq meereb yom tob velo matza bah betza — yesh lachush shemma noleda ballayla, veen anu tolin lomar sheyyotza rubbah meereb yom tob vechozra, lepi shehu dabar sheeno matzuy, veap al pi shelledatah ballayla hu gam ken dabar sheeno matzuy, mikkol maqom mide sapeq lo yatzanu shemma noleda belel yom tob, veap al pi shehu sepeq dibre soperim, mikkol maqom kevan shehu "dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin" — hechemiru bo chakamim apillu nitorba baacherot, kemo shennitbaer lemala.

Abal im lo badaq meereb yom tob, ap al pi sheenah yekola labo etzel hattarnegol — habbetza mutteret, sheanu tolin lomar shebbeereb yom tob noleda bayyom, shehare ap habbetzim hannoladim belo tarnegol rob happeamim darkan lehivvaled bayyom, vezeh shemmatza habbetza qodem or hayyom — min hassetam noleda meereb yom tob.

Lepikak, muttar liqqach betzim min hannokri belel yom tob rishon, demin hassetam noledu meereb yom tob, veken haddin belel yom tob sheni shel galuyyot, shehabbetza shennoleda beyom tob rishon mutteret beyom tob sheni. Abal betzim hanniqqachin minnokri belel yom tob sheni shel rosh hashshana, veken belel yom tob shelleachar hashshabbat — asurot, shemma noledu beyom shellipne layla zeh.

Nokri hammebi betzim beyom tob rishon, umesiach lepi tummo veomer shennoledu meereb yom tob — muttar lismok alayv, lepi sheissur betza shennoleda beyom tob eno ella middibre soperim, ubekol issure dibre soperim somekin al nokri mesiach lepi tummo, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman s"t. Lepikak, im hebi betzim beyom tob rishon shechal lihyot achar hashshabbat, sheissur betza shennoleda bo bayyom hu min hattora — en somekin al hannokri shemmesiach lepi tummo veomer shennoleda beereb shabbat. Abal yom tob sheni shechal lihyot achar hashshabbat, apillu hu yom tob sheni shel rosh hashshana, kevan sheeno ella middibre soperim kemo sheyyitbaer besimman t"r — muttar lismok al hannokri mesiach lepi tummo.

Veakshav bimdinot ellu shemmetzuyim harbeh betzim limkor umebiim harbeh bebat achat — vadday rob habbetzim shemmebiin limkor hen hannoladim meetmol, lepikak ap beyom tob rishon sheachar hashshabbat en bebetzim ellu issur min hattora, sheanu omerim: "kol deparish merubba parish", umin hassetam hen mehannoladim meetmol beshabbat, veen kan issur ella middibre soperim kemo shennitbaer lemala, lepikak im hannokri hu mesiyach lepi tummo veomer shemmeereb shabbat noledu — muttar lismok alayv.

Vekol zeh keshehannokri eno yodea shebbetza shennoleda hayyom asura leyisrael, abal im hu yodea mizzeh — en somekin alayv ap al pi shehu mesiach lepi tummo, deshemma hu maarim kede sheyyiqchu mimmennu. Abal im habbetzim hen shel hayyisrael venokri mesiach lepi tummo veomer shennoledu meereb yom tob o meereb shabbat, ap al pi shehu yodea shebbetza shennoleda hayyom asura leyisrael, mikkol maqom, kevan shellannokri beatzmo en maggia shum toelet mimmah sheyyeshaqqer lomar shennoleda meereb yom tob — muttar lismok alayv, kevan shehu mesiach lepi tummo. Abal im shoalin oto ematay noleda, kevan shehu yodea sherotzim lismok al amirato — chosheshin shemma yeshaqqer.

Tarnegolet shennishchata beyom tob umatza bah betzim — muttarot apillu hu yom tob sheachar hashshabbat vehabbetzim hen gemurot im qelippatan kemo shergilin lihyot bishat ledatan, veen chosheshin shemma im lo haya shochatah hayu noladin hayyom venimtza shekkebar nigmeru meetmol beshabbat, deap shennigmera beshabbat en zo chashuba hakana ella im ken noleda al yede gemar zeh, abal keshello noleda al yede gemar zeh — en gemar zeh niqra hakana, lepi shettaam habbetza hu shaveh qodem gemar zeh veachar gemar zeh.

Eproach shennolad beyom tob — asur baakila ubetiltul ad haereb, mippene shehu muqtzeh, veap hammattirin muqtzeh beyom tob — modim bemuqtzeh kazeh shead sheyyatza haeproach laavir haolam lo haya rauy liklum, veap hakkelabim lo hayu okelin oto keshehaya biqlippato. Veim nolad beshabbat — asur beyom tob shelleacharayv min hattora, lepi sheal yede leda zo hukan laakila, vekevan shebbeshabbat i epshar leshochoto uleoklo — nimtza shehukan beshabbat leoklo beyom tob shelleacharayv, ukebar nitbaer deen shabbat mekina leyom tob.
